subject.title: fix: suppress exec-like tool error warnings regardless of includeDetails

question: Should exec-like tool failures with details be globally suppressed before mutating handling, or should cron, heartbeat, and full-verbose contexts continue surfacing warnings?
rationale: Current tests encode visible warning/detail behavior for several exec paths, so an automated repair cannot safely choose whether the suppress-all policy is intended.

options.title: Clarify Policy Then Repair
options.body: Confirm the intended exec-like warning contract, then update policy ordering and tests to match that contract.

options.title: Preserve Current Detail Paths
options.body: Keep cron, heartbeat, and full-verbose exec warnings visible and narrow the linked issue to the specific noisy path that should be suppressed.

options.title: Pause This Branch
options.body: Leave this PR unmerged until the contributor or maintainer supplies a revised patch and real behavior proof.
